description: Maps test-matrix evidence buckets to executable evidence identifiers and the claim level they prove. This catalog does not make a row release-ready by itself; the release tracker owns sufficiency.

assertions: Unsupported or native-blocked behavior fails before native side effects.
Bitcoin funding, send, receive, and balance flows work against the controlled regtest stack.
Channel creation, lookup, and payment state survive the covered funded regtest paths.
Lightning invoice/payment paths work in the covered funded regtest smoke.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps HODL invoices, APay, LSP config, and VSS clear fence
assertions: HODL invoice helpers and the covered funded settlement path preserve required metadata.
RGB issue, receive, send, and transfer listing behavior works for the covered funded regtest flow.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps RGB asset balance and issuance methods
assertions: Supported RGB asset type APIs preserve request and response shape for the covered paths.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps LSP APay proof and address attestation wire fields
assertions: APay/LSP request mapping, validation, and proof DTOs preserve current core field names.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::LSP outbound liquidity wait throws on timeout
assertions: LSP HTTP policy, timeouts, and retry boundaries fail in controlled ways.
Known unsupported native behavior fails explicitly and cannot be cited as implemented.
One installed app recovers the same external-signer node/channel state across process restart.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::coalesces concurrent init and unlock lifecycle calls
test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::rejects regular operations after shutdown until reinit
assertions: Lifecycle state transitions and basic node readiness work without funded operations.
Invalid app-facing inputs fail before native mutation for the covered fields.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::initializes, unlocks, and delegates address lookup
assertions: Read-only node, balance, invoice, peer, and list paths work for the covered unfunded smoke.

testIds: test/rln_manager_contract_test.dart::RLNManager exports RN-style defaults and lifecycle helpers
assertions: Compatibility aliases delegate to the intended canonical implementation.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::uses RN-shaped Lightning and on-chain wrapper contracts
assertions: Dart request/response contracts, validation, and delegation match the documented shape.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps supported responses into core-style DTOs
test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::canonicalizes native enum and status casing at model boundary
assertions: Wire-to-domain mappers preserve required fields, optionality, units, and enum/status normalization.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps Lightning helpers to canonical RN status shapes
test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::unknown Lightning send status maps to null
assertions: Status helpers normalize current native/RN vocabularies and reject or quarantine unknown values.
Pure Dart validators and crypto utilities satisfy their current vector suites.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::matches RN-core seed derivation and utility behavior
assertions: Deterministic vectors match the pinned upstream/core expectations.

testIds: test/utexo_wallet_test.dart::maps HODL invoices, APay, LSP config, and VSS clear fence
assertions: VSS-facing facade calls preserve shape for current supported recovery-adjacent behavior without claiming local backup support.
